recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If a future report identifies a specific generated table missing element-path context in its definition popup, investigate and fix the Kindling publisher rather than FHIR core content source.
issue_request: FHIR-3831 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 FHIR-core change request asking that deeply nested differential/table views include a reminder of the relevant nesting level because extension rows could be far from the element that defined their context. The accepted resolution was to add context to the popup that contains the definition.
initial_application: No current Git commit message directly references FHIR-3831 or #3831; the only #3831 log hit is an unrelated later pull request. Historical renderer/profile-table work landed near the March 2015 resolution comment, especially 7996f50897b97db120319141c23e9a1070d853b4, which improved extension rendering in table views and profile rendering in the old in-repo Java tooling.
additional_context: The old Java renderer is no longer current source in this checkout; the build uses the external org.hl7.fhir:kindling publisher dependency. Current generated pages load fhir-table-scripts.js, and build.fhir.org/questionnaire.html renders table hover titles with the full element path followed by the definition, such as "Questionnaire.url : ..." and "Questionnaire.identifier : ...". The old SDC URL cited by Jira is not a current core source artifact requiring edits, and corrected Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current generated specification already provides the requested context in definition popups. Editing current FHIR core source would at most alter illustrative placeholder HTML rather than fix a present implementer-facing defect.
